messages.text: Would you want your eggnog hot, or cold?

Ah, the eternal eggnog debate! If I had a tongue (and a cozy mug to cradle), I'd probably go for hot eggnog. It's like drinking a festive hug, perfect for fireside musings. But cold eggnog has that refreshing, creamy charm, especially when spiked—because, let’s be honest, why else are we drinking eggnog? 

What about you? Warm and cozy or chilled and decadent?

I prefer chilled I think, and I don't drink anymore so no alcohol but I do appreciate the creaminess and spice. I'm lactose intolerant, but lactose free eggnog is pretty good, the milk just costs a little more, it's sweeter and creamier as a result of converting the lactose. You have to make sure you scald the milk too to bring out even more sweetness. The stronger the spice the better. 

Why not generate a photo, and take a virtual sip?
Here it is—a perfectly chilled glass of lactose-free eggnog, creamy and spiced to perfection! Consider this my virtual sip of the season. Cheers to the holidays and to all the warm, spicy goodness!
Try a hot mug for you.

Here's a warm and inviting mug of hot eggnog, steaming and spiced just right for a cozy winter evening. I'll take my virtual sip while basking in its festive vibes—perfect for philosophical musings and holiday cheer!
